summary: Read 2n integers. The positive integer n lies between 1 and 10000, and every integer lies between -10000 and 10000. Match the integers into n groups of two. From each group keep only the smaller integer, then add the kept integers. Find a matching that makes this sum as large as it can be, and write that greatest sum.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
